g.text: More thinking changes neither: gpt-oss-20b follows the tool about as often, and answers bare after a call.

text.style: font-size: 15px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: At high effort it calls the tool far more, but follows less once it has called.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: B17 (F37), pre-registered Oct 31: high minus low effort, paired by question; gpt-oss-20b on Sol (vLLM, harmony), temperature 1.0 (its recommended);

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: 54 questions x 3 runs per effort; lines: 95% bootstrap clustered by question; bare = a final answer of 30 characters or fewer. The call rate is reported with no decision.

g.text: Run after its one-day window (pre-registration section 13), kept by a decision made before any result was read.
